reviews.t: Awesome 2 in 1 device for a good price.
reviews.x: The Brori 2 in 1 concept is very nice. I’ve used the hair cutting feature and had no issues. I like how the haircut length adjustments are built into the unit so you don’t have to put different size clips to get a shorter or longer cut. The shaver is a nice touch and can be used in the shower since it’s waterproof. It won’t get as close as a high end Braun electric shaver but it still does a good job. Charging the unit is also effortless and the battery holds enough charge for a haircut and a sh

I bought this for my husband and he loves it!! The ease of using the hair clippers, they are so light compared to other models. He also loves having the shaver on the other side. Lightweight and convenient!
Not bad for the price. Clean shave. Has adjustments on the clipper to adjust size.

reviews.t: Great body groomer with a close shave!
reviews.x: I recently decided to try the Brori body groomer as a replacement to the Philips Body Groomer, which eventually fell apart.  The Brori has a good build quality and works well.  It is a bit thicker and bulky around the close trimming/shaving head, and about the same as the Philips on the clipper end.  None of these seems to impact its performance, so I have rated a full 5 stars based on my experience with this product.

I purchased this product on Prime Day 2020 to replace an older trimmer that stopped charging, so there is not much run time or testing.  So far so good. The manual states to "please use the provided lubricating oil for proper operation" but there was no oil included, so I sent an email to the company. reviews.t: Works great in and out of the Shower!!
reviews.x: Works great in the shower, that’s reason I purchased this item, because it was waterproof. I’ve used a couple times already and haven’t had any skin irritations or those unsightly bumps associated with shaving areas that aren’t used to be shaving. All in a great product at a great price!!

This razor is pretty cool. I like how its 2 in 1. My son says it pulls the hairs on his face. I have used this on my legs and underarms with no problems. I also tried in the bikini area with great luck. So maybe my son is more sensitive. So just keep that in mind.
Easy to maneuver and operation. Really like the built in length adjuster instead of fumbling for separate parts.. Maintains a good charge can do entire body grooming in a single charge.

reviews.t: Clean shave and easy to use.
reviews.x: Works great! Very comfortable to use. Trimmer level is easily adjusted and the foil shave head is very smooth. Cleans up super easy with a quick rinse.
Affordable and excellent quality product that does the job.  The dual sided feature is an added advantage. Recommend the product.

I purchased the Brori groomer because of the reviews.  Previous Mangroomer products had a short life, cost more, but did shave very well.  My current Phillips Norelco groomer does not groom as closely.  Thus far, the Brori grooms better than any unit I've owned.  It charges fast, is quiet, and the head follows body contours better than my past units.  It will be interesting if the groomer performs for me as it has for others.  The head life is going to be the true test.  For the price, I am impr

I've been using it for a month and a half and haven't had any problems. Both modes are easy to use, it shaves closely, and the charging stand makes it easy to keep on standby. Well worth the purchase for me. 👍
I was very excited to receive this product and I was not disappointed.  this razor delivered a very close shave.

The ceramic trimmer edge works really well and better than others I’ve used in the past. I don’t find much use for the other end and it doesn’t cut nearly as well as the ceramic trimmer. Overall, I’m happy with the purchase.

This product does a great job trimming my husband’s beard and mustache.  The charging station has a small footprint which is great for our small vanity top.  We bought this during Prime Days and it was an excellent value.

This covers all your shaving needs. It cuts through long hair and closely shaves the short hair. The trimmer guard and shaving head are both removable for cleaning. I’ve uploaded a video that should show this soon.
Groomer was good. Used it to trim my beard and has the options to chose the size. Used to use clippers to do so and this made it easier no wires and no no extra plastic clippers

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product as easy to use and convenient.
Many reviewers consider it good value for the price.
Several reviewers highlight its lightweight, compact, and portable design.
Some reviewers mention the 2-in-1 clipper and shaver design as a plus, including waterproof shower use.
A few reviewers report negatives such as poor durability, bulkiness, hair pulling, or missing lubricating oil.
